description: The propagation engine removes the values that the constraints rule out, until no constraint can remove more: the *fixpoint*. Each constraint is a *propagator* that prunes the domains of its scope. At the root every propagator runs once; after that, a changed domain queues only the propagators that watch its variable, each at most once and first in, first out, and a propagator that changes its own scope runs again. A propagator that would empty a domain stops the run with a conflict, and a trail records every change so that search can undo it on backtrack. Use it under backtracking search, so that each choice prunes the other domains before the next one.
